image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned centrally in the frame. The crab's broad, oval carapace is reddish-brown with lighter mottling and white speckles. Two stalked eyes protrude from the anterior margin. The first pair of legs are modified into large, robust claws (chelipeds) with dark tips, resting in front of the body. Several walking legs are visible extending laterally, though some are partially occluded or cut off by the frame edges. The background shows blurred metallic surfaces and parts of other crabs, suggesting a market or seafood display setting.
